entities.summary: Massimo "Bullo" Bulleri is an Italian professional basketball coach and former player. During his playing career, standing at a height of 1.88 m tall, he played at the point guard and shooting guard positions. He is currently the head coach for Dinamo Sassari in the Italian Lega Basket Serie A (LBA).
